title: aMQTT: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity and Uncontrolled Resource Consumption and Improper Input Validation…
description: aMQTT versions 0.11.0 through 0.11.3 contain a denial-of-service vulnerability due to improper MQTT topic-filter validation combined with catastrophic regular-expression backtracking. A malicious client can freeze the broker by sending a crafted SUBSCRIBE packet with malformed topic filters containing multiple '+' wildcards, causing the broker's event loop to block. This results in complete broker unavailability until the process is restarted. The issue is patched in version 0.11.4.
